headline: RBI Proposes Stricter Rules for Gold-Backed Agricultural Loans
summary: The Reserve Bank of India has proposed tighter checks for banks classifying gold-backed agricultural loans as priority sector lending, potentially increasing banks' PSL requirements.
why: Changes to priority sector lending rules can impact bank balance sheets and the availability of credit for specific sectors, influencing lending strategies.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Regulatory changes regarding loan classification affect capital allocation and compliance costs for banks.
